notablePrerequisites: There are at least three colors among permanents you control.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bloom Tender, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Bloom Tender from your graveyard to the battlefield with haste and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{G}.
Repeat.
